description: This file contains performance monitoring and tuning functions for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It defines utility functions for resource usage logging, SQL timing, and database performance diagnostics, along with a class 'adodb_perf' that provides methods for activity monitoring, SQL analysis, and UI components for performance visualization.

classes.name: adodb_perf
classes.description: Class providing methods for database performance monitoring, SQL diagnostics, and UI for performance data presentation. Includes functions for gathering CPU load, SQL timing, logs, and generating performance dashboards.

methods.name: adodb_getmem
methods.description: Returns the current process memory usage in KB, or 0 if not available.

methods.name: adodb_round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified precision, formatting it with a dot as decimal separator.

methods.name: adodb_microtime
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp with microsecond precision.

methods.name: adodb_log_sql
methods.description: Logs and times the execution of an SQL statement, inserting performance data into a designated table and possibly creating the table if needed.
